name: Madatschen
kurzbeschreibung:
**Hike through Serfaus**

Discover the breathtaking alpine world of **Serfaus** on foot! The **Madatschen** trail is a true gem for hikers, offering stunning views of the **Ötztal Alps** and the charming village below.

Start your adventure at the **Serfauser Bergbahnen** cable car station and follow the well-marked path through lush meadows and past crystal-clear mountain streams. The trail winds through serene forests, where you’ll encounter rare alpine flowers and perhaps even spot a chamois or marmot.

At the summit, reward yourself with a hearty meal at one of the cozy mountain huts. Try a classic **Kaiserschmarrn** with fresh berries or a warming bowl of **Tiroler Gröstl**—perfect after a day of exploring.

Whether you're a seasoned hiker or just starting out, the **Madatschen** offers an unforgettable experience in the heart of **Tirol**. Don’t forget your camera—this trail is pure magic!
